remarks: Exceptional One Level Luxury Living at Park Tower Stamford. Fabulous Corner Penthouse 3BR with Breathtaking Park Views! Large Primary Suite with white marble bath - spa tub and separate walk-in shower. Each bedroom with private full bath. Special Living rm Entry to 3br/Office/Den. Balcony overlooking the Park. Freshly Painted. Enjoy First Class Services and many Amenities for convenient luxury lifestyle. 24/7 Concierge Service! All Season Pool, Fitness Center, Resident Lounge for entertaining. Spectacular Rooftop lounge with views of NYC Skyline and Long Island Sound. Special Shuttle to Train, Rent parking around $200+/Car. Pet Friendly. Enjoy events in Downtown Stamford - Restaurants, Mill River Park, Pickle Ball and More!
